report.title: HP natural-placement judge V3 — V6.1 grouped by source input (10 prompts each) — cashmere | laptop_FrontCloseUp

rows.comment: Looking good. Ideally, we'd have an additional prop or two on the table, and the background supports additional props, whether it be a view of the window or if we are going to have a blue wall. There is some sort of wall hanging to break up the background to add some dimension.

Good composition and framing of product, clear separation from the background. Only feedback would be that the water carafe might not be the ideal prop to be used in this situation, especially as close as it is to the laptop.
Good output. Only feedback would be to bring the framed picture into the frame a little bit more.
Good output. Only feedback would be to bring the framed picture into the frame a little bit more.

Overall, this output is okay. The prop decision of a rock would probably fail this as an output to be used. In addition, it would be great to have some sort of wall hanging or art in the background to break up the white space.
Okay, output: The placement of the table is off and would not replicate a real-life scenario.

This output is okay. Within a gaming environment the prop selection would likely differ to ensure a successful production-based image. In addition it would be great to have some sort of wall-covering art or something to break up the background to add depth to the environment
Ok output. Props on table should be different, and the use of a white board should not be blank if used.
